opening.argument: The title openly presents Forsage as a network-marketing earning platform and supplies a contact number: “Forsage Blockchain: Most Valuable Network Marketing Earning Platform Contact Us: 03191543590.” The footage reinforces that earning proposition by displaying claimed BUSD earnings alongside partner, team, and matrix figures, while the narration highlights purported results: “He made $372 and almost $10,000.” That presentation is consistent with a recruitment-commission and tiered-matrix model rather than an ordinary product offer. The SEC’s charges against Forsage operators and promoters over an alleged crypto pyramid scheme, where earnings depended on recruitment, provide project-level context. That allegation does not claim this uploader was charged, and the sparse footage alone does not establish every aspect of the broader scheme, but it supports treating the promotional earnings-and-contact presentation as scam-related.

citations.quote: Forsage Blockchain: Most Valuable Network Marketing Earning Platform Contact Us: [PHONE]
